messages:
violet: FYI: all-hands next Monday 11:00am PT. Theme: Post-launch retro + short policy brief (data retention & telemetry). Format: 8m exec context, 12m launch metrics & RCA summary, 10m policy update, 8m customer stories, 7m lightning demos, 5m live Q&A. Please drop any must-cover bullets here by Fri EOD.

ryan: Calendar invite is live: <https://calendar.redwood.com/event/2991112222>. Added a notes doc and shared deck link.

amela: For the policy brief: we'll announce the new 90-day telemetry retention default and options for extended retention in Dedicated/Private plans. Will include migration steps & how to request exceptions.

chao: Ops note: we'll surface the deploy-induced cache warmup that caused a 2m tail-latency spike during launch. Short RCA will be included in the metrics block; full postmortem to be posted to #incidents after the meeting.

violet: Accessibility reminder: captions ON; transcript attached post-meeting. If you require interpreter services reply: "interpretation: yes".

amela: ACTION: please review the draft policy doc in the drive and comment by Thu so we can finalize slides. Link: <https://drive.redwood.com/policy/telemetry-retention-draft>.

ryan: LIVE question from product: will the new retention default affect customers on older API versions?

amela: LIVE answer: no immediate breaking changes. Default applies to new projects and can be retroactively applied with customer consent; we'll include an FAQ and contact flow.

ops-bot: Reminder: recording will start automatically; transcript + slides posted to #all-hands-resources. Notifications scheduled: 48h, 2h, and 10m before start.

violet: Action items summary: 1) Teams: add must-cover bullets by Fri EOD. 2) Amela: finalize policy slides & FAQ by Fri EOD. 3) Chao/Ops: post the incident one-pager after final review. 4) Ryan: publish final agenda Mon AM. Thanks! :megaphone:
